text:
alex_cs: Quick check-in on BlueNova — dedicated pool utilization looks alarming this week, want to surface before Friday renewal sync.
leah_support: saw the alert this morning, GPU hours trending +48% vs commit.
marco_sre: current saturation at 92% peak, sustained ~85% M-F, queue depth spiking to 37 during evenings.
alex_cs: raw numbers? need to call out burn rate for renewal conversation.
marco_sre: yesterday: 1,820 GPU hours/day, commit is 1,200 — cushion gone. 7-day avg ~1,450.
jing_customer: yep team ramped a new batch job on Mon, expected to be temporary for onboarding tests. We pushed to smaller batch but still high.
oliver_pm: is there a cheap knob — rate limit or auto-burst policy we can toggle to smooth?
marco_sre: options: 1) apply soft throttling to non-prod tags, 2) enable short-term burst from spare pool (cost delta ~15%), 3) schedule some heavy jobs to off-peak window.
capacity-bot: [alert] BlueNova-dedicated-pool saturation >=90% for 3 hours — incident ticket #INC-4583 created.
alex_cs: tagging @jing_customer — can you confirm whether onboarding jobs can be queued to 2–4am PST window?
jing_customer: yes — we can shift 60% of onboarding batches to midnight window, need 48h to validate.
leah_support: I'll prep customer-facing note: propose 2-week burst + schedule shift plan, share cost impact and mitigations.
oliver_pm: also propose temporary commit increase until renewal — if they commit additional 600 hours/mo we avoid burst costs. Can we model cost quickly?
marco_sre: quick calc: extra 600h/mo ~ $9k/mo; burst estimate for peak month ~ $1.8k for 2 weeks.
alex_cs: add both options to renewal deck. Leah, Marco — please own action items.
leah_support: on it, will draft note and run approval by legal for any pricing change.
marco_sre: I'll open a short runbook: throttle non-prod tag, enable burst window, and add simple grafana dashboard for queue depth by tenant.
jing_customer: confirming we'll start shift tomorrow evening for a test run — ping me if any unexpected failures.
alex_cs: thanks — can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when they have their action started.
leah_support: :white_check_mark:
marco_sre: :white_check_mark:
jing_customer: :white_check_mark:
oliver_pm: :white_check_mark:
capacity-bot: [info] INC-4583 updated: runbook attached by marco_sre.
